data.title: AMIS wheat 25 Nov: Punjab median eases 5.9% to Rs13,063 per 100 kg on 14 mandis
data.summary: Median Rs5,225 per 40 kg on 25 Nov, down from Rs5,550 on 24 Nov but still 24% above 1 Sep; Kamalia Rs5,750 and Chichawatni Rs5,650 top the range, TT Singh Rs4,100 and Jauharabad Rs4,450 the low.

data.title: Sindh fixes official flour price at Rs138/kg and will feed mills imported and Passco wheat directly
data.summary: Sindh set the official wheat flour price at Rs138/kg (against Karachi fine flour at about Rs210/kg on 23 Nov) and will supply imported wheat and Passco stocks straight to flour mills, with action promised against hoarding; no release price or quantity was given.

data.act: Cover winter wanda needs for 30–45 days this week with quotes from two flour mills, in one lot rather than tranches; use the 25 Nov dip in wheat to press for bran at or below last week's level.
data.why: AMIS Punjab wheat median eased 5.9% to Rs130.6/kg on 25 Nov (14 mandis, Rs5,225 per 40 kg) after jumping to Rs138.8/kg on 24 Nov, and is still 24% above 1 Sep. Sindh fixed flour at Rs138/kg on 25 Nov and will supply imported and Passco wheat directly to mills, while TCP's third 800,000 t import tender closes 30 Nov, so bran stays firm through winter until the April harvest.
